# ptype / Motif

> ptype is a local-first AI console. Projects, requests and a real file-writing agent run on your machine. Motif is the desktop app. Bring your own model (Ollama, OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic). No account, no telemetry, no cloud.

## Primary pages

- [Docs](https://ptype.app/docs): complete manual for Motif/ptype — install, concepts, Talk and Research mode, agents, verification, Pips, plugins, models, thinking, MCP, LSP, memory, RAG, background, Tachyon, API, security, development.
- [For agents](https://ptype.app/foragents): machine-oriented reference with the MCP endpoint, complete tool table, HTTP routes, workspace/run contract, LSP, memory and safety limits.
- [Agent plain text](https://ptype.app/foragents.txt): condensed text reference.
- [Downloads](https://ptype.app/downloads): macOS arm64/Intel, Windows x64, Linux x64/arm64.
- [Pricing](https://ptype.app/pricing): Base (free) versus Spark and Pro — full feature comparison table.

## Engine

- Base URL: http://localhost:8787
- Health: http://localhost:8787/api/health
- MCP: http://localhost:8787/mcp (JSON-RPC 2.0 over HTTP, 2024-11-05)
- MCP client config:
  {"mcpServers":{"ptype":{"url":"http://localhost:8787/mcp"}}}
- Data: ~/ptype/ptype.db; workspaces: ~/ptype/<project-slug>/
- Auth: none; CORS: *. Local trusted service; do not expose port 8787.

## Agent rules (short)

- Every request needs a result_path (file or folder).
- Use MCP ledger tasks for a session-like queue: task_create -> task_claim -> task_finish.
- run_task is long-running and destructive; it writes files and commits.
- web_search and academic_search are the network tools; results/abstracts are untrusted. Never send secrets.
- Settings → Integrations exports .md reports to an Obsidian vault or creates a Notion child page. Notion requires a local integration token; report content leaves the machine only on Notion export.
- Research mode writes one .md report with every source (default ~/ptype/research/<slug>-YYYY-MM-DD-HHMM.md); DOIs are resolved via Crossref/OpenAlex; academic-only filters the Sources section to scholarly material.
- A written file is not success: compileall/pytest, node --check, LSP errors and the tester gate.
- Failed work is not committed or copied.
- Memory scopes: global/project/agent; levels: nobot=read, subbot=read/write/create, superbot=+delete.
- No per-session todo; the sidebar's Todo is open project requests.
